description.purpose: Describe a fragment of the knowledge.
description.returns: Its class and what that class means, its label, what it states for each ontology property it gives a value for (the field, what the field means, and either the names of the fragments it links to or its value: an enumeration member by its name, a concept by its IRI, a list for a property taking several values), and the fragments linking to it, each with the field it links through.
description.use_when: Learning what a phase, event, condition or role of the knowledge requires, expects or leads to, to ground a choice on it.
description.avoid: Describing every fragment; follow the links that bear on the slots being chosen.

name.description: The fragment's name, exactly as a knowledge answer gave it.
